name: Crema (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, the white charged with the municipal arms of Crema (red over white) on a yellow sunburst with a helm and crest.
history: Municipal flag of Crema, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Crema arms — red over white on a yellow sunburst, with helm and crest
